seed1.name: seed1_<site>_<prior>
seed1.inputs: FINALTRAIN stage1/<stem> seeds+maps and targets/<stem>.npz, read-only
seed1.existing_gtjudge_stage4: none found on disk (checked 2026-11-11); all are trained here

na.unchanged_note: position_lr_max_steps and all learning rates keep the code values (학습률 불변)

campus_inputs.images: WIDEN0-v2 image_split.json: train 819 (training list), evaluation 118 (--eval test list). Same 937-model poses and PINHOLE K scaled to 1024x741 as fork_inputs_v6; JPGs resized from p0-audit colmap_dense/images with cv2.INTER_AREA, JPEG 95 (fork_inputs_v6 rule)
campus_inputs.mvs_background: WIDEN0-v2 mvs/full/stereo/depth_maps/<name>.JPG.geometric.bin (1024x741), conf = depth>0 (same as the stage0 export: verified on B0 view DJI_20241217084241_0004_D, box export == box geometric depth>0 exactly)

patches_and_judgments.site_patches: for the three FINALTRAIN sites: FINALTRAIN targets/<site>__<prior>.npz rows copied unchanged (h, sigma, region, judge_region, reason, normal, area)
patches_and_judgments.other_patches: JUDGECHECK-v1 core_points/<tile>__<prior>.npz (development buildings: ALS roof 122, LoD2 roof+wall 125): rule row 0 'new_clipped' of region/reason, photo_code row 0; targets by FINALTRAIN targets.calculate() applied once to all non-site patches of one prior (correction u_M median over those patches)
patches_and_judgments.dedup: a JUDGECHECK building that already has patches in any FINALTRAIN site stage0 input (TARGET stage0_r1 'building') is taken from the site file only; JUDGECHECK patch_id duplicates across tiles are dropped (first tile in sorted order)
patches_and_judgments.no_judgment: buildings without a new-rule judgment (19 confirmation buildings: only old-rule judgments exist; other LoD2 buildings outside the judged scope) get no prior patch and are background; count and footprint area are recorded
patches_and_judgments.GT_fields: JUDGECHECK gt_p, gt_status, cell, old_cell are never read
patches_and_judgments.sigma_ref: one per campus x prior: area-weighted rule of FINALTRAIN over all active campus patches (site + other)
patches_and_judgments.prior_seeds: site patches: FINALTRAIN site seeds (origin 1 rows of stage1/<stem>/seeds.npz: xyz=target, normal, quaternion) unchanged; other patches: one seed per active patch at its target with quat_from_normal(normal) (LoD2 site rule = one seed per active patch; ALS site rule used TIN vertices, campus TIN vertices are not available -> nearest rule, recorded)
patches_and_judgments.background_seeds: campus SfM points minus exclusion cylinders of all campus patches (exclude_cylinders_r2.cpp, radii configs/phd/main_target_v1/revisions/r2/target_v1.json inherited_radius, half-length roof 10 m wall 5 m)
patches_and_judgments.background_sigma: hypot(median of finite kind-1 MVS u over all campus patches, 0.0275)
patches_and_judgments.maps: prepare_maps_r7.py rasterizer/draw unchanged; background pixels = campus MVS depth where conf>0, weight 1

campus_inputs.scene_extent: code default (scene.cameras_extent = nerf_normalization radius); recorded per run with percent_dense*extent and 0.1*extent

cells.ground_plane: local x-y (EPSG:25832 axes); camera centres projected by dropping z
cells.count: k = round(819/200) = 4 -> m x n = 2 x 2; split x into m columns with equal camera counts (median), then each column along y into n rows with equal counts; outer boundaries extend to infinity
cells.expand: each finite cell edge moved outward by 20 % of the cell's extent along that axis (extent of the cell's own camera centres when the cell is unbounded on the opposite side)
cells.camera_selection: (1) cameras whose centre lies in the expanded cell; (2) other training cameras if the convex hull of the projected 8 corners of the expanded cell box, clipped to the image, covers >= 25 % of the image area; box z range = 0.5th-99.5th percentile of campus SfM z inside the expanded cell
cells.points_and_targets: SfM points and campus patches whose centre xy lies in the expanded cell; maps drawn from those patches only; sigma_ref and background sigma kept at the campus values (one scene = campus)
cells.merge: after training, keep Gaussians whose xy lies in the original (unexpanded) cell; concatenate the four 30,000-iteration point_cloud.ply files
cells.records: per cell image count, SfM point count, prior patch count, seeds; for each evaluation box: which cells it touches and whether a cell boundary crosses it
cells.boundary_band: evaluation reference rows within 2 m (xy) of an original cell boundary line; completeness and floating fraction (rows with signed normal-line distance s > +tau) counted separately

mesh.rule: PHD-RESCORE-v1 addendum 3 mesh rule as run by GTJUDGE mesh_job.py (render_model surf_depth, TSDF 0.05/0.25, auto:18 tiles, bounded cleanup)
mesh.views: for every run the baseline site training view list: RESCORE addendum3_stage2/views/B0_b10.json (243), R1rep_b10.json (333), RESCORE views/B173nb_b10.json non-virtual (203)
mesh.execution: GTJUDGE scripts unchanged; /gtjudge mounted at PH/main_trainunit_v1/.../gt with read-only links to the GTJUDGE inputs they read

scoring.scorer: GTJUDGE score_new.py (normal-line rows, stage1 cells, tau of RELEASE stage0) + add2_scores.metric_rows(accuracy_rule='euclidean_1m') = addendum 2 section 3.4 accuracy rule
scoring.baseline_values: docs/experiments/phd/main_gtjudge_v1/tables/addendum2/stage1/<site>__<prior>.csv method FINALTRAIN_30000 and comparison methods prior, mvs, fusion, baseline_30000, GeoGS_30000, 2DGS_30000, CDGS_30000
scoring.four_cases: case_id 0 both right, 1 image only right, 2 prior only right, 4 no image; scene = case 'all'
scoring.max_gap_to_best: per site x prior: over the four cases, max over cases of (best completeness among {run, prior, mvs, fusion, baseline_30000, GeoGS_30000, 2DGS_30000, CDGS_30000} minus run completeness), same for accuracy; cells with n_gt < 1000 excluded

comparisons.question: 같은 학습 횟수에서 전체 대 칸
건물 중심 대 영상 수 칸; 칸 경계 띠 따로

gpu.priority: PHD-MAIN-TRAINERR-v1 first; launch only when nvidia-smi shows no compute process on that GPU (desktop graphics processes excluded)
gpu.pre_launch: do not launch if now + minimum FINALTRAIN wall time of the same prior (ALS 4468 s, LoD2 6557 s) > deadline; the 500-iteration rule then decides
gpu.at_500: projected total = 147.1 x elapsed at iteration 500 (largest total/elapsed500 among the six FINALTRAIN runs); if now + projected - elapsed > deadline the run is stopped and recorded as not completed (time)
gpu.at_deadline: a running run gets a stop file; at its next multiple of 100 iterations the unchanged jbgs_state capture writes a complete state, then it stops
order: ga ALS GPU0 | da ALS GPU1
seed1 (B0, R1, B173 order; reduced from B173 first)
gpu.idle_fill: if a GPU is free while campus/cell inputs are not ready, a seed1 run may be launched when its pre-launch estimate ends before the expected input-ready time
gpu.retry: execution error or OOM: one retry with the same settings; then 결과 없음 with Gaussian count and GPU memory at failure

outputs_psnr: train PSNR = code's 5 training-camera evaluation line at 30,000 (log); test PSNR = metrics_30000.txt; both recorded
appendix_selection_rule: order appendix copied verbatim in the order file; not used by this agent
